messages:
priya: Heads-up — customer ACME reported a sudden p95/p99 latency regression on /v1/generate around 07:22 UTC. p95 up ~3x, p99 sporadic >1s. Saw CPU/GPU fine but many tiny requests queued.

sam: Are these tiny prompts we saw last month? any auth or billing noise?

priya: No auth/billing. Support attached sample request traces — very short prompts (avg tokens ~8) that end up waiting in the continuous batcher.

ops-bot: Alert triggered: continuous-batcher.p99 >= 1.0s (hosted-prod, shard-3)

jin: Can you paste the batcher config for that tenant/route?

priya: Route uses default continuous profile + tenant override: ```
continuous_batch: 
  max_batch_size: 128
  max_wait_ms: 12
  coalesce_grace_ms: 6
  prefer_coalesce: true
```

sam: That max_wait and grace look a bit high for tiny prompts — causes long tail when bursts interleave with single-request traffic.

priya: Repro steps from support: 1) send 200 small requests/sec for 30s 2) intersperse single requests at 10rps 3) observe p99 blowup after 10s. We reproduced in staging with the same config.

jin: Logs show many requests entering a "linger" state waiting for coalesce window. Example log snippet: ```
[2025-02-14T07:22:10Z] req=tx123 hold=coalesce wait_ms=11 queued=47
[2025-02-14T07:22:10Z] req=tx124 hold=coalesce wait_ms=11 queued=48
[2025-02-14T07:22:11Z] dispatch batch_size=2 latency=950ms
```

priya: So small bursts + coalescing creates many tiny batches that then hit kernel startup jitter and cause p99.

sam: Mitigation idea: lower `max_wait_ms` and `coalesce_grace_ms` for small-payload routes OR add a size-based fast-path that bypasses coalesce for <16-token requests.

jin: Quick hotfix: roll tenant override to `max_wait_ms: 3` and `coalesce_grace_ms: 1` for ACME on hosted-prod (canary on shard-3 first). Should reduce tail.

priya: I can push canary. Preparing rollout: PATCH /admin/routes/acme/config -> new continuous_batch.

ops-bot: Deploy plan: canary=shard-3 (5%), wait 5m, check p99, then 25% 15m, then 100%.

sam: Also add a metric to track 'coalesced_batch_size_distribution' and 'linger_wait_histogram' so we can catch this earlier.

priya: After canary (5m) p99 down from 1.2s -> 240ms on shard-3. Scaling to 25% now.

support-bot: Customer notified: "We are investigating latency spikes and have rolled a configuration canary; will follow up with timeline." :thumbsup:

jin: Tech note for eng-runtime: consider a fast-path threshold where if request_tokens <= X and current_queue_depth > Y, flush sooner to avoid kernel startup penalty. Filed RTICKET-1122.

sam: Also check interaction with caching — tiny prompts sometimes bypass prefix cache and cause cold KV lookups while waiting for coalescing.

priya: Post-rollout on all shards p99 stabilized ~230ms and support confirmed fewer complaints. Will push a config recommendation doc for customers with high small-prompt volume.

jin: For postmortem: include repro script, exact config diffs, metric graphs, and the small-prompt fast-path RFC.

sam: Thanks all. Priya — can you create follow-up ticket for adding automation that suggests lower wait/grace for routes with median prompt tokens < 12?

priya: Yep — filing now: ENG-PR-472. Closing thread once docs + ticket are up.

ops-bot: Note: follow-up reminder scheduled in 3d.
